{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows where either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g is missing
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute Pearson correlation between flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g
correlation = df_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(df_clean['body_mass_g'])

# Print the correlation coefficient with 3 decimal places to match the expected output
print(f'{correlation:.3f}')"}
